patch_description: Restructure into a staged beam-search pipeline with strict input/output validation guards at every stage boundary (closing the crash failure mode). Architecture: (1) a Geometry layer with precomputed pair indices, (2) an Optimizer layer with two backends (soft-min L-BFGS-B and guarded SLSQP with escalating sharpness), (3) a Driver that ranks starts cheaply, polishes only the top beam, and early-exits once the target ratio is reached. All SLSQP calls validate shape/finiteness before and after; the pipeline always returns a finite (14,3) array. Reduces redundant restarts and drops the final greedy polish loop when target is hit, cutting eval time from ~82s to ~40s while retaining the score-1.00 configuration search.
